name: Avalanche
source: [spoiler]Formerly known as Maya Lindgren, a Swedish doctor who was a part of the Mars colonizing project. She was a psychologist with close relationship with the other people in Calamity Monkeys. She was brainwashed by Shannon into believing that, for the sake of humanity, it was necessary that she and the others put humanity to the test.  She has the ability to greatly reduce temperatures in her immediate area and summon massive amounts of snow, causing avalanches even on flat ground. Resignation and sorrow define her personality, after her transformation, and she is perhaps the most human of the four fully-adult Calamities.[/spoiler]
